scope: Clean-slate second stage after whole-message labelling
status: Standalone component; application integration and semantic acceptance pending
pass_condition: Given a label, the complete latest message and complete attributed earlier conversation, make one preparation call and return an explicitly unreviewed reply draft, source-linked material proposals and planned activities without executing, saving or publicly releasing them.
consequential_counterexample: A mistaken broad label must not remove original information or requests from the preparation input. An unknown source or NM-only source must not admit a material or action proposal; a rejected independent proposal must not discard supported peers or turn its draft into approved public text.

input.latest_message: Exact original text with a code-assigned source ID
input.earlier_conversation: Complete ordered messages with original speaker, words and supplied attribution metadata
input.label: Advisory whole-message classification; not execution authority or a content filter
input.first_message: Code selects the opening-message prompt when history is empty
input.follow_up: Code selects the follow-up prompt with complete attributed history

output.reply_draft: Unreviewed response proposal handling greeting, attributed understanding and proposed activities as applicable
output.material: Proposed understandings with source message IDs and code-owned proposal IDs
output.actions: Planned requested outcomes, constraints, activities and consequential missing information with original source IDs; proposals are not execution permissions
output.sources: Complete original source messages retained separately from derived proposals
output.issues: Explicit held-unit identity and validation reason; supported independent peers retained

checks.input: Validate label, nonblank current input, attributed history and explicit history completeness before dispatch; refuse overflow without trimming history
checks.output: Validate the envelope once and each independent unit separately, including required text and owned source IDs. Reject support supplied only by earlier NM wording; require the latest message to anchor a current action. Normalize blank optional constraints and missing-information metadata without rejecting a valid action.
checks.completed_schema_rejection: Per-unit validation may examine a quarantined provider object only when the existing shared model boundary supplies a complete, unambiguous structured rejected-result receipt. Every unit still requires its own checks; incomplete output is never salvaged.
checks.limits: Source identity is not semantic support, extraction completeness, factual proof, authority to execute, persistence or public release approval

calls.recovery: No private retry. Typed failures remain available to the later shared turn-owned recovery boundary.

offline_tests.coverage: First and follow-up prompts, complete source context, two-call component handoff, advisory labels, source identity, held independent units, harmless empty metadata, quarantined completed objects, unfinished output, resource overflow and no private retries

verification.browser: Not run; component is not wired into the public application
verification.semantic_accuracy: Not established by scripted responses or mechanical source validation

remaining: Wire complete owned context and the labelling handoff through the application boundary
Independently review substantive draft, material coverage, source meaning and planned work before admission or public release
Add shared bounded recovery without re-admitting user input or repeating successful effects
Save checked material and work through owned atomic persistence and derive completion from actual effects
Execute authorised planned activities through their owners and retain outcome evidence
Validate model behaviour and actual saved/reopened browser replies

workbook.visual_review: Updated status and notes rendered and viewed without clipped text
